items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He looked like Jonathan Edwards, got a big picture of Jonathan Edwards.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. Getting back to one of those things, you look like someone, now we played up in Yale and George Brunis told Peewee

He looked like Jonathan Edwards, got a big picture of Jonathan Edwards. And George (Brunis) told Peewee that he looked like him, see it was almost the same you know. Because we were having lunch at that time.
But when they called that 'The House of Meditation' I mean that had to do with the Rosicrucianists thing.
